title: sse: fix streaming chunking/framing for partial JSON, delimiter and token/event ordering
author: Arielle Chen
description: This PR fixes multiple SSE streaming edge-cases observed in production and reported by partner integrations: (1) partial JSON objects split across SSE chunks could be emitted in the wrong order or with missing delimiters, causing clients to see invalid partial JSON; (2) delimiter/event ordering bugs where data/message/event tokens could interleave incorrectly when structured output (function/tool calling) produced mixed token types; (3) token/event ordering regressions that led to truncated function call payloads in streaming mode. The change updates the SSE framing and chunking layer to preserve atomic delimiter semantics, enforces a canonical emission ordering (control delimiters before data tokens and message boundaries after token groups), and stitches partial JSON fragments deterministically before emitting an SSE event. The PR touches both the OpenAI-compatibility layer and the internal runtime streaming path to ensure compatibility with existing client expectations. Implementation notes: added an explicit non-blocking assembler in streaming path that holds incomplete JSON fragments and merges them when next chunk arrives, introduced a small state machine to guarantee delimiter ordering for partial structured outputs, and added heuristics to safely flush long-running partial fragments to avoid head-of-line blocking. Thorough unit and integration tests added for token/event ordering permutations, plus a small benchmark harness to confirm no regression in p50 latency and negligible p95 impact. This is a backward-compatible bugfix with no API schema changes; highlights in changelog and docs updated to describe deterministic SSE ordering semantics for structured outputs and function/tool calls.
commits: fix(sse): deterministic assembler for partial JSON fragments (holds and merges across chunks)
fix(openai-compat): enforce delimiter ordering for structured outputs and function calls
test(sse): add integration tests for token/event ordering and partial-json recombination
docs: document SSE deterministic ordering and examples for function/tool calling in streaming mode
perf: microbenchmark to validate no regression on p50 latency when assembler enabled
